links.outcome: Objective readability (Lix, Flesch-Kincaid) of AI-written vs human-written plain language summaries
links.effect: Lix and Flesch-Kincaid scores were high for both groups (hard to read), with ChatGPT slightly easier to read (p < .001). Assessors rated ChatGPT readability 2 points higher on a 10-point scale (p = .002).
links.quote: Lix and Flesch-Kincaid scores were high for both groups of summaries, though ChatGPT was slightly easier to read (p < .001).

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to draft plain language summaries of systematic reviews, with blinded editorial and layperson assessment against guideline checklists

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the capability of ChatGPT-4o to write plain-language summaries for Cochrane systematic reviews in an offline reader study involving editorial staff and laypersons, without comparing or evaluating a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
